about: Encode chains for every deliverable. vf is: scale first (BT.709 matrix, limited range), then format=, then setparams (research Q-F1). The colour-patch test (pipeline/validators/colour_patch.py), not this text, decides whether a chain may say approved:true: a chain above 3/255 on any build tested is not approved. expect.profile is null on purpose: render.mjs compares every non-null expect key with a fixed ffprobe set that has no profile, so a filled profile would give a false mismatch after every render; the profile is asserted through expect_extra (colour_patch.py) and by spec_check profiles. Extra keys beyond the 4.5 shape, all additive: alpha, expect_extra, approved, measured (per ffmpeg version, 6.1.1 only until the maker runs the PC build, 9.0.2 UNVERIFIED), used_for. approved:true means approved on the builds listed in measured.

h264_venue.used_for: venue file (W-17): 1080p24 H.264 High 4.1, CRF 18 with a 20 Mbps cap, AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo 256 kbps, faststart, metadata stripped
h264_venue.notes: Q-F1 recommended H.264 line plus the W-17 venue limits. Loudness is set by the audio stage, not here (three venue masters, W-19).

h264_backup_main40.used_for: backup venue file (W-17): Main 4.0 at about 8 Mbps for old players
h264_backup_main40.notes: Bitrate figures are the register's 'about 8 Mbps'; maxrate 10M and bufsize 16M are the planner's proposal (J).

h264_online.used_for: online / private-link copy (W-19: -16 LUFS, -1 dBTP) and the access copy
h264_online.notes: CRF 20, 10 Mbps cap and AAC 192 kbps are the planner's proposal (J); the register fixes only the colour, -16 LUFS and -1 dBTP.

prores422hq_master.used_for: the master (W-15): ProRes 422 HQ, 10-bit 4:2:2, Rec.709 limited range, PCM 24-bit 48 kHz
prores422hq_master.notes: color_range is null (not asserted): ffmpeg 6.1.1 leaves a ProRes range tag 'unknown'; newer builds may write tv. spec_check accepts both for ProRes.

prores4444_alpha.used_for: alpha overlays only (titles, grain, line-draws). Not a master.
prores4444_alpha.notes: ffprobe on 6.1.1 reports yuva444p12le for a yuva444p10le encode; another build may report yuva444p10le (spec_check accepts both). The bare -pix_fmt yuva444p10le encode is BT.601 on 6.1.1: never use it. EffectCraft issue #340: prefer an RGBA PNG sequence.

ffv1_lossless.used_for: lossless intermediate and the pre-encode master for the MO8 gate (4:4:4 10-bit, BT.709 limited, so it is tagged and survives a later conversion)
ffv1_lossless.notes: Lossless relative to the 4:4:4 YCbCr, not relative to an RGB source (the RGB to YCbCr step rounds). Files are large: keep clips short (MO8 uses at most 96 frames).
